timed_text.text: You've done your first week. Breathing. Body scan. Awareness.
Today we build the tool that ties all of it together.
A word, a short phrase, or a physical sensation that your mind comes back to when it starts to drift.
It should be short — one or two words max. Process-focused, not outcome-focused.
Examples: next play, breathe, process, here, trust.
Before we start — take one box breath to settle in.

steps.text: What is your focus anchor? One or two words. Choose something that brings you into the present moment.
Hold your anchor. When your mind drifts — and it will — bring it back. That's the rep.

timed_text.text: That word you just saved — that's your reset tool.
In competition, when things get loud in your head, that's what you come back to.
We're going to use it throughout the rest of this program.
Go hit the journal. That's your first week of Relentless.

blocks.prompt: What anchor did you choose and why? When in competition do you think you'll need it most?
